description: Constructed. 'Possible minimally displaced right 6th rib fracture' vs 'Minimally displaced right 6th rib fracture': certainty major (possible vs definite right 6th rib fracture, two steps; a possible fracture is sent for more imaging); 'No definite pulmonary embolism' vs 'No pulmonary embolism': certainty minor (no definite vs no pulmonary embolism, one step; both still rule out the embolism); 'Enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes, suspicious for…' vs 'Mildly enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes, likely reactive': diagnosis major (suspicious for metastases vs likely reactive nodes; adds an oncologic workup), grade minor (pred leaves out the mild grade of the node enlargement; a low grade left out changes nothing); 'Mild emphysema' vs 'Mild centrilobular emphysema': diagnosis minor (pred leaves out the centrilobular subtype of emphysema; same management).
